title: Bit-Flip Attacks on Quantized Neural Networks without Knowledge of Model Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2611.32128v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We show that quantization asymmetry concentrates bit-flip vulnerability in small tensors retained at high precision. CoarseHammer targets these tensors and accepts flips at any bit, without parameter values, gradients, or data. It remains effective under continued fine-tuning. Under ideal placement, CoarseHammer reaches chance accuracy in at least 81.5% of runs on each of ten evaluated models, including four large language models, with median successful runs requiring at most 24 flips. On simulated DRAM with 0.01 flippable bits per million, it outperforms three prior attacks on every evaluated convolutional network, succeeding in up to 83.6% of runs while they never succeed. On a real system, CoarseHammer steers heap-allocated tensors onto vulnerable frames despite address space layout randomization, without accessing the model file. translated_title: 无需模型参数知识的量化神经网络比特翻转攻击
translated_abstract: 我们证明了量化的不对称性将比特翻转攻击的脆弱性集中在以高精度保留的小型张量中。CoarseHammer正是针对这些张量发起攻击，并且可以在任意比特位实施翻转，而无需知道参数值、梯度或数据。即使模型持续进行微调，该攻击仍然有效。在理想放置条件下，CoarseHammer在十个被评估模型（包括四个大语言模型）中的每一个上，至少有81.5%的运行能将模型精度降至随机猜测水平，成功运行所需翻转次数的中位数最多为24次。在每百万比特中仅有0.01个可翻转比特的模拟DRAM环境下，该攻击在每个被评估的卷积网络上都优于三种先前攻击方法，成功率最高达83.6%，而先前方法从未成功。在真实系统上，即使存在地址空间布局随机化（ASLR）保护，CoarseHammer也能将堆分配的张量引导至易受攻击的内存帧，且无需访问模型文件。使用16个模板化内存帧时，所有四个语言模型的中位数精度均降至随机猜测水平，大约……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: CoarseHammer是一种无需模型参数、梯度或数据的比特翻转攻击方法，它利用量化不对称性将攻击集中于高精度保留的小型张量，可在任意比特位实施翻转，仅用最多24次翻转就能在包括大语言模型在内的多种神经网络中取得超过81.5%的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: CoarseHammer is a parameter-agnostic bit-flip attack that exploits quantization asymmetry to target small high-precision tensors, allowing flips at any bit position and degrading models—including four LLMs—to chance accuracy in over 81.5% of runs with at most 24 flips.
